plainText:
Emily Jenness is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of and . She was born Emily Ann Bauer and is also credited as Emily Blau. She is currently affiliated with CESD Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Jenness was born as Emily Ann Bauer on July 29, 1981, in New Jersey. After graduating from New York University in 2002 with degrees in Business and Theatre, she became a voice actress and voiced several characters in her career. Jenness joined in the tenth season. Her most notable role is that of 's friend . She has also provided voices for various characters since.

==Trivia==
Jenness's name is often misspelled as Emily Jeness.
She also voiced Nene in Samurai Warriors 3, whom the design and characterization for Nene in Pokémon Conquest were based on.
